title: Onion Samurai Tea Party
description: A large transparent bubble floats over a lily pad pond, containing an angry anthropomorphic onion samurai holding a katana while seated at a purple table with a robotic teapot and teacups. A woman in a white feathered hat and futuristic outfit leans on the bubble from outside, set against a surreal autumn landscape with a red city skyline, floating bubbles, and a dramatic swirling sky.
prompt: A giant transparent bubble floating over a pond covered in lily pads contains an angry anthropomorphic onion samurai with a fierce expression holding a katana, sitting at a purple floating table with a blue robotic teapot pouring tea into cups. A stylish woman in a large white feathered hat and white futuristic jacket with blue accents leans on the bubble from the right side. Background shows a red neon city skyline at dusk, autumn trees with red and orange leaves, more floating bubbles containing tiny scenes, and a dramatic swirling pink and purple sky with shooting stars.
